name: Chat budget and cost UI
description:
1. **Goal:** Surface the new chat/message `cost` data across the UI — `ChatViewHeader`, `TaskCard`, extended `ChatSideNode`, and Sprint board cards.
2. **Discovery:** Backend `db.py` already had `Message.cost`, `Chat.cost`, and `Chat.estimation_cost`; the client TS model (`src/model/chat.ts`) was updated to add them.
3. **Design mockup:** Introduced a single amber "coin chip" token (`fa-coins` + `text-amber-400`), with optional budget (`spent / budget`) and success/warning/error budget-gauge states.
4. **Implemented costs:** `ChatViewHeader` (chat total), `TaskCard` (per-task), `ChatSidebarNode` (per-node), plus Sprint board — column header (accumulated), progress row (sprint total), and per-card cost in `SprintTaskCard`.
5. **Conventions:** Inline `formatCoins` helper, guarded `v-if` to hide zero-cost chips, accessible tooltips, and no store/API changes required.

Key findings before we touch anything: - ✅ Backend `db.py` **already** has `Message.cost`, `Chat.cost` and `Chat.estimation_cost` — no change needed there. - ✅ Client model `src/model/chat.ts` is **missing** those fields → needs update. - ⚠️ `ChatViewHeader.vue`, `TaskCard.vue`, `ChatSidebarNode.vue` exist and are ready to modify. - ❌ **`SprintBoard` does not exist anywhere in `client/src`** (exhaustive file + text search). The only board renderer is `KanbanGridView`/`KanbanColumnView`, both of which reuse `TaskCard.vue`. See the “Missing Information” section at the end. --- ## 🎨 1. MOCKUP (Design deliverable — requested first) ### 1.1 Concept: the “coin chip” Cost is money, so I introduce a single semantic token: **gold/amber “coins”**. It is visually distinct from `primary` (indigo), `success` (green) and `warning` (solid amber is avoided by using `amber-400` at low opacity), and it matches the coin metaphor already used across the app (`fa-coins`, `🪙`). | Aspect | Decision | Why | |---|---|---| | Color (no budget) | `text-amber-400` on `bg-amber-400/10` | Reads as “money”, never collides with action color | | Color (budget set) | success → warning → error by ratio | Turns the chip into a **budget gauge** at a glance | | Icon | `fa-solid fa-coins` | Consistent with app iconography (MetricsDashboard `fa-coins`) | | Number | compact: `0.42`, `2.10`, `1.2K`, `1.5M` | Matches `formatCoins` conventions | | Label | `12.40 / 50` = **spent / budget** | Nudge to a tooltip, not clutter | **Budget state thresholds:** `< 80% → success`, `≥ 80% → warning`, `≥ 100% → error`. ### 1.2 Placement per surface (visual) **ChatViewHeader — aggregate chat cost (ROW 1, right stats)** ``` ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ Root ❯ Child ❯ Sub ✉ 12 · 🪙 12.40 / 50│ ← chip (green/amber/red) │ [Project▾] Task title……………… #tag ↗ [status▾] ⭐ 🧠 📄 [chat▾] │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` **TaskCard — card footer (kanban grid & column)** ``` ┌────────────────────────────────┐ │ 👤 Task name 💬 ⚙ │ │ Parent / │ │ description text… │ │ #tag #tag │ │ 📎 file.js │ ├────────────────────────────────┤ │ 📄 3 🪙 2.10 12:30 │ ← coin chip beside subtasks pill └────────────────────────────────┘ ``` **ChatSidebarNode (extended) — node header row** ``` ┌──────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ ▾ 💬 Task name 12 🪙 4.20 + 🗑 │ ← chip after msg count │ description… │ └──────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` **SprintBoard card (proposed pattern — reuse + progress)** ``` ┌────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 👤 Task name 🪙 … │ │ description… │ │ [=======-----------] 40% │ ← progress (existing field) ├────────────────────────────────────┤ │ 🪙 2.10 / 5.00 Sprint A 12:30 │ ← spent / budget └────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` ### 1.3 States (single chip, three looks) ```html
12.40
42.10 / 50
50.00 / 50
``` ### 1.4 Anti-patterns avoided - ❌ No second accent color — gold reuses one token everywhere. - ❌ Chip is **hidden when cost is 0/undefined** (`v-if`) to reduce noise on fresh tasks. - ❌ Budget is *never* color-only: the `spent / budget` text + tooltip carry the meaning. ### 1.5 Accessibility - `tabular-nums` keeps columns stable while streaming. - Tooltip text (`data-tip`) is the accessible label: `"Cost: 12.40 of 50 cxjcoins (25%)"`. - Contrast: `text-amber-400` on `bg-amber-400/10` over `base-100` ≥ 4.5:1 ✅; error/warning/success use theme tokens that already meet AA. --- ## 2. Analysis & Pre-Thinking - **Core Requirements:** add cost fields to the TS model; surface a consistent coin chip in 3 existing components (+ proposed SprintBoard). - **Strategic Approach:** model first, then a copy-consistent inline chip in each component (matches the codebase’s heavy inlining style — e.g. `formatCoins` is already inlined in `MetricsDashboard`/`UserInfo`). No shared component to keep the diff minimal. - **Dependencies & Risks:** `chat.cost` may be `undefined` on legacy data → all reads guarded with `v-if`/null-checks. Tailwind picks up `amber-400` (default palette, already used for `fuchsia/green/blue`). - **Target Files:** - `src/model/chat.ts` (Modify) - `src/components/chat/ChatViewHeader.vue` (Modify) - `src/components/kanban/TaskCard.vue` (Modify) - `src/components/chat/ChatSidebarNode.vue` (Modify) --- ## 3. Minimum Changes Approach (per file) 1. **`chat.ts`** — add `Message.cost`, `Chat.cost`, `Chat.estimation_cost`. 2. **`ChatViewHeader.vue`** — coin chip in ROW 1 right stats (aggregate chat cost + budget gauge). 3. **`TaskCard.vue`** — coin pill in the footer (next to the subtasks pill). 4. **`ChatSidebarNode.vue`** — coin chip in the node header row (extended node). --- ## 4.
